end.summary:
Practised distinguishing point, line segment, line and ray by endpoints and arrows.
Aryan identified line segments as having two endpoints and lines as extending in both directions.
They initially said a ray has two endpoints; later described a ray as starting at one endpoint and extending in one direction.
Teach-back was not passed; 2 of 6 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying points, line segments, lines and rays using endpoints, arrows, and direction. Aryan explained line segments and lines clearly; the ray mix-up was corrected later by describing a torch beam that starts at one endpoint and continues in one direction. At home, ask them to draw each figure and mark its endpoints and arrows.
